Taskmaster-3 (TM-3-2020, TicketTalk)

Creators: Bill Byrne, Karthik Krishnamoorthi and Saravanan Ganesh, Google LLC.

Source: https://github.com/google-research-datasets/Taskmaster/tree/d92cb6af3005f1dc09c39e75e7daf4a04905e00b/TM-3-2020
Files: TM-3-2020/data/data_00.json to data_19.json

The licensor provides the material as is and makes no warranties about it.

Changes: Syntropy's parity corpus (parity-corpus-v1 and later) uses the turn
text of selected dialogs. Turns are mapped to user and assistant roles,
consecutive turns by one speaker are joined, the API records are left out,
and each conversation is rendered with a model family's chat template and
tokenized. The turn text is otherwise unchanged.
